_nota: Textos de interfaz de las paginas de libro, uno por idioma. El español tambien esta aqui y sale identico a como salia antes de que existiera este archivo: es un idioma mas, no un caso especial. Para añadir un idioma: se copia el bloque 'en', se traduce, se crea herramientas/libros/<idioma>/ con una capa por libro, y se registra su menu en navegacion.py. Los titulos de los libros NO se traducen. Los fragmentos NO se traducen: el esquema de la capa no tiene donde ponerlos, a proposito.

catalogo.seo_titulo: The books of Antonio López Sánchez
catalogo.seo_desc: Fourteen books by the Cuban writer Antonio López Sánchez: the Nueva Trova, poetry, heroic fantasy, horror and children's books. World rights outside Cuba.
catalogo.subtitulo: Fourteen published books, in the order that makes sense from outside Cuba.
catalogo.intro: Titles are kept in their original Spanish, with their meaning in brackets. Every page carries the back cover, the author's own note on the book, excerpts in Spanish, and full details for publishers.

cierre.texto: World rights for editions and translations are available outside Cuba, where the author's publishers keep their exclusivity. Full manuscripts and synopses are available on request.

grupos.texto: Anthologies and shared volumes that include texts by the author. Rights offered here cover only what he wrote, never the complete volume.
